name: Patanjali nariyal
ingredients: Wheat flour (Atta-55.5%), Sugar, Refined palm oil, Invert syrup, Desiccated Coconut powder (1.85%), Milk solids, Raising agents [INS 503(i), INS 500(ii), INS 341}], lodized Salt, Honey, Emulsifier INS 322(1), Desi ghee, Dough conditioner (INS 223), Nature Identical flavouring substances (Elaichi & Coconut).
